comparison.objective: Mix liquids by side-to-side test-tube waggle; candidate separates solids with a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated constrained vessel oscillation without vertical shaking versus bounded screen tilt/agitation to clear particle bridges.
comparison.success_condition: Both tubes mixed and returned without spill versus ≥98% media passage, full washer retention, and no loss.
comparison.reason: Agitation is shared, but one tests prescribed liquid mixing while the other tests selective aperture passage and retention.
